rules: No default Inter for H1/H2. Use Outfit for high-end technical feel.
Headings > 32px MUST use tracking-tight.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + tracking-[0.2em].
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Never use pure black or gray, use tinted obsidian. Background is #050505.
Always set hover states explicitly (e.g., hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] hover:text-white).
Text must meet APCA / WCAG AA contrast ratio.

surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look): Use border-r and border-b for data grids and tables.
Neumorphism (Tactile): Flat solid surfaces with 1px border-white/5 for cards.
Avoid Heavy Glass: For dashboards, use solid backgrounds to prevent visual refraction of data.
effects: Subtle Glows: Use var(--accent-glow) for active tabs or critical KPIs.
Tracing Beam: Use sparingly on high-priority upgrade or active warranty claim cards.

rules: Cards: Go cardless or use rectangular dense styles. Max 8px border-radius.
Tables: High density. Left align data, right align numbers. Subtle border-b between rows.
Inputs: Use Shadcn Input/Select. Solid backgrounds (bg-[#111111]), no transparent dropdowns.
Buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangles. Interactive hover states with transform.
Charts: Use Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Stick to monospaced numbers for tooltips.
Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4.
Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
Every pixel utilized, use h-full to match neighbors.
Direct Children Only: Grid items MUST be direct children.

layouts.spacing_scale: p-4 to p-8 internally for widgets, generous margins for section gaps.
rules: Mobile-first responsive grids.
Navigation: Sidebar Navigation for the dealer portal (Dashboard), Top bar for User/Quick Actions.
Optical alignment over geometrical.
Micro-interactions on hover (opacity and slight transforms).
Staggered entrance animations for table rows or grid items.
No universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Include data-testid on ALL interactive elements.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
High contrast focus rings focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent.

product_showcase_cables.description: Premium orange USB-C cables, useful for promotional asset section.

product_showcase_charger.description: Sleek white charger, for product listing.

product_lifestyle.description: Black smartphone charging. Perfect for auth background or portal welcome.

warehouse_boxes.description: Yellow and white logistic boxes to represent inventory/warehouse.

warehouse_racks.description: Warehouse racking system to illustrate scale and storage.

steps: Use Recharts for complex data in Lagerbestand (Inventory Trends) and Revenue visualization.
Use Framer Motion for progressive disclosure and smooth page transitions.
Avoid heavy 3D canvases in the data-heavy portal areas; focus on raw performance and clarity.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate, but favor solid dark panels for data grids to maintain high contrast.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Do not add `transition: all`. Transition specific properties.
Use sonner for toast notifications for success/error handling (e.g., Warranty submitted, Order placed).
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-reorder-btn').
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or headers. Always have a solid or slightly translucent fill.
Always provide a prominent North Star KPI (e.g., Active Stock, Pending Orders) on the top-left.
Group metrics intuitively: Orders, Inventory, Revenue, and Support.
Mobile-first responsive design, even for B2B dashboards.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the BidBlitz Charge Händlerportal using React and Tailwind.
Create a robust Layout with Sidebar navigation for switching between Login, Lagerbestand, Nachbestellung, Rechnungen, Werbematerial, Garantieabwicklung.
Ensure the UI reflects a premium hardware brand comparable to Anker/UGREEN—sleek, dark, technical, and highly readable.
Use the provided `App.css` and `tailwind.config.js` conventions for dark mode aesthetics.
Integrate Shadcn primitives (Card, Table, Badge, Button, Input) heavily customized for the dark theme.
